scientific_integrity: Proof includes an exact Gram identity, Gaussian row tails, Karamata summation, and the finite-density Riemann limit. The previously published pure-harmonic special case is not claimed as novel. No independent review or external formal certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified Bauschke–Tung Gaussian orbit for admissible regularly varying increments with an existing extended limit of \(n d_n\); arbitrary firmly nonexpansive operators and general oscillatory meshes are not classified.
title: Sharp Cesàro trichotomy for regularly varying Gaussian meshes
